div.head: II Eg 3.1
div.ab: Gif hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecweden habbað, þonne fare pæs cyninges gerefa to ⁊ þæs biscopes ⁊ þæs mynstres mæssepreost ⁊ niman unðances þone teoðan dæl to þam mynstre ðe hit togebirige, ⁊ tæcan him to ðam nigoðan dæle, ⁊ todæle man ða eahta dælas on twa, ⁊ fo se landhlaford to healfum, to healfum se biscop, si hit cyninges man si hit þegnes.

If, however, anyone refuses to render tithes in accordance to what we have decreed, the king's reeve, and the bishop's reeve, and the priest of the church shall go to him, and, without his consent, shall take the tenth part for the church to which it is due, and the next tenth shall be alloted to him, and the eight [remaining] parts shall be divided in two, and the lord of the manor shall take half and the bishop half, whether the man be under the lordship of the king or the thegn.

⁊ gyf hwa þonne ða teoðunge gelæstan nelle, swa we gecwedan habbað, fare þæs cynges gerefa tó ⁊ þæs biscopes ⁊ þæs mynstres mæssepreost, ⁊ niman unþances þæne teoðan dæl to þam mynstre, þe hit togebyrige, ⁊ tæcan him to ðam nigeðan dæle; ⁊ todæle man þa eahta dælas on twá, ⁊ fó se landhlaford to ealfan, to ealfan se biscop, sy hit cynges man, sy hit þegnes.
